According to Fox News, that marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in the network's polling during either of his two terms in the White House. President Trump’s approval rating dropped to 30 percent in a new Pew Research survey, amid growing dissatisfaction with his handling of foreign policy, the economy and immigration enforcement. Sixty-eight percent of respondents disapproved of the way Trump is handling his job, according to the survey, which was released Thursday. Fifty-seven percent of Trump’s 2024 Hispanic backers approve of his performance in office, while 69 percent of his 2024 voters overall approve of his handling of his job.
